confidence_notes: Numbeo Palermo, updated 15 October 2026, showed €13.50 for an inexpensive meal, €50 for a mid-range meal for two, €5 draft beer, and €1.83 cappuccino. Cocktail and wine prices are bounded estimates relative to local beer; the one 2026 rooftop menu I viewed listed classic cocktails at €12–15. Hostelworld showed starting prices rather than annual typical rates, and my searches did not surface annual hotel-class averages, so accommodation anchors are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used direct Palermo price data; no comparable city was needed.
